_note: Classical Chinese verse (public domain). season: spring/summer/autumn/winter or absent for any time of year. festival entries replace the daily pick on that lunar date. English: translation and title_en are the app's own translations; authors_en and dynasties_en give names in pinyin.

spring_festival.name: 春节
spring_festival.author: 王安石
spring_festival.title: 元日
translation: Amid firecrackers the old year departs;
the spring wind brings warmth to the New Year wine.

lantern.name: 元宵
lines: 众里寻他千百度，蓦然回首，
lantern.author: 辛弃疾
lantern.title: 青玉案·元夕
translation: I searched the crowd for you a thousand times; suddenly I turned,
and there you were, where the lantern light was dim.

dragon_boat.name: 端午
dragon_boat.author: 文秀
dragon_boat.title: 端午
translation: Who first named this festival?
Through the ages, they say it was for Qu Yuan.

qixi.name: 七夕
qixi.author: 秦观
qixi.title: 鹊桥仙
translation: One meeting of golden wind and jade dew
outshines countless meetings in the human world.

mid_autumn.name: 中秋
mid_autumn.author: 苏轼
mid_autumn.title: 水调歌头
translation: I only wish that we live long,
and share this moon though a thousand miles apart.

double_ninth.name: 重阳
double_ninth.author: 王维
double_ninth.title: 九月九日忆山东兄弟
double_ninth.title_en: Thinking of My Brothers on the Double Ninth
translation: Alone in a strange land, a stranger,
on every festival I miss my family twice as much.

new_years_eve.name: 除夕
new_years_eve.author: 高适
new_years_eve.title: 除夜作
translation: Tonight my thoughts travel a thousand miles home;
tomorrow my frosted temples will be a year older.

poems.author: 王维
poems.title: 终南别业
translation: I walk to where the stream runs out,
and sit to watch the clouds rise.

poems.author: 王维
poems.title: 山居秋暝
translation: The bright moon shines between the pines;
clear springs flow over the stones.

poems.author: 王维
poems.title: 使至塞上
poems.title_en: On a Mission to the Frontier
translation: In the vast desert a lone column of smoke rises straight;
over the long river the setting sun is round.

poems.author: 王维
poems.title: 鸟鸣涧
translation: At ease, I watch the osmanthus fall;
the night is still, the spring hills empty.

poems.author: 王维
poems.title: 积雨辋川庄作
translation: Over misty paddies white egrets fly;
in the deep summer shade the orioles sing.

poems.author: 张九龄
poems.title: 望月怀远
poems.title_en: Gazing at the Moon, Thinking of One Far Away
translation: Over the sea the bright moon rises;
at the ends of the earth we share this moment.

poems.author: 孟浩然
poems.title: 春晓
translation: Sleeping in spring, I miss the dawn;
everywhere I hear the birds.

poems.author: 孟浩然
poems.title: 宿建德江
translation: The plain is wide, the sky sinks below the trees;
the river is clear, the moon comes close.

poems.author: 孟浩然
poems.title: 夏日南亭怀辛大
poems.title_en: Summer Day at the South Pavilion
translation: The breeze off the lotus carries their scent;
dew drips from the bamboo with a clear sound.

poems.author: 孟浩然
poems.title: 过故人庄
translation: We open the window onto the garden,
and over wine we talk of mulberry and hemp.

poems.author: 李白
poems.title: 行路难·其一
translation: A time will come to ride the wind and break the waves;
I'll hoist my sail to the clouds and cross the sea.

poems.author: 李白
poems.title: 将进酒
translation: Heaven made my talents for some use;
spend a fortune, and it comes back again.

poems.author: 李白
poems.title: 早发白帝城
translation: The apes on both banks call without end;
my light boat has passed ten thousand hills.

poems.author: 李白
poems.title: 月下独酌·其一
translation: I raise my cup to invite the bright moon;
with my shadow we make three.

poems.author: 李白
poems.title: 独坐敬亭山
translation: We gaze at each other and never tire —
only Jingting Mountain and I.

poems.author: 李白
poems.title: 黄鹤楼送孟浩然之广陵
poems.title_en: Seeing Meng Haoran Off to Guangling
translation: A lone sail's far shadow fades into the blue;
I see only the Yangtze flowing to the edge of the sky.

poems.author: 李白
poems.title: 宣州谢朓楼饯别校书叔云
translation: Our spirits soar, our thoughts take wing;
we would climb the blue sky and gather the moon.

poems.author: 李白
poems.title: 峨眉山月歌
translation: A half-moon of autumn over Mount Emei;
its light falls in the Pingqiang and flows on.

poems.author: 杜甫
poems.title: 望岳
translation: One day I will stand on the very top,
and see all other mountains small below.

lines: 好雨知时节，当春乃发生。
随风潜入夜，润物细无声。
poems.author: 杜甫
poems.title: 春夜喜雨
poems.title_en: Welcome Rain on a Spring Night
translation: Good rain knows its season and comes when spring arrives;
it slips into the night on the wind, soaking everything without a sound.

poems.author: 杜甫
poems.title: 登高
translation: Endless leaves come rustling down;
the boundless Yangtze rolls on and on.

poems.author: 杜甫
poems.title: 奉赠韦左丞丈二十二韵
poems.title_en: To Minister Wei, in Twenty-Two Rhymes
translation: Read until ten thousand scrolls wear thin,
and your brush will write as if inspired.

poems.author: 杜甫
poems.title: 绝句
translation: Two orioles sing in the green willows;
a line of white egrets climbs the blue sky.

poems.author: 杜甫
poems.title: 月夜忆舍弟
poems.title_en: Thinking of My Brothers on a Moonlit Night
translation: From tonight the dew turns white;
the moon is brightest over home.

poems.author: 王之涣
poems.title: 登鹳雀楼
translation: To see a thousand miles further,
climb one more storey.

poems.author: 孟郊
poems.title: 登科后
translation: Proud in the spring wind, my horse's hooves fly;
in one day I see every flower in Chang'an.

poems.author: 高适
poems.title: 别董大
translation: Don't fear the road ahead holds no friends —
who under heaven does not know you?

poems.author: 王勃
poems.title: 送杜少府之任蜀州
poems.title_en: Seeing Off Prefect Du to Shu
translation: While a true friend lives within the seas,
the ends of the earth are next door.

poems.author: 王勃
poems.title: 滕王阁序
poems.title_en: Preface to the Pavilion of Prince Teng
translation: Evening clouds fly with a lone wild duck;
autumn water and the endless sky are one colour.

poems.author: 王湾
poems.title: 次北固山下
translation: The tide is level, the banks spread wide;
the wind is fair, a single sail hangs high.

poems.author: 崔颢
poems.title: 黄鹤楼
translation: Across the sunlit river, Hanyang's trees stand clear;
on Parrot Isle the fragrant grass grows thick.

poems.author: 张若虚
poems.title: 春江花月夜
translation: Who first saw the moon from this riverbank?
In what year did the moon first shine on us?

poems.author: 岑参
poems.title: 白雪歌送武判官归京
poems.title_en: Song of White Snow, Seeing Off Secretary Wu
translation: As if a spring wind had come overnight,
a thousand, ten thousand trees burst into pear blossom.

poems.author: 王昌龄
poems.title: 从军行
translation: A hundred battles in yellow sand have worn through our armour;
until Loulan falls, we will not go home.

poems.author: 柳宗元
poems.title: 江雪
translation: Over a thousand hills, no bird in flight;
on ten thousand paths, no footprints.

poems.author: 刘禹锡
poems.title: 酬乐天扬州初逢席上见赠
poems.title_en: Reply to Bai Juyi at Our First Meeting in Yangzhou
translation: Past the sunken boat a thousand sails go by;
before the withered tree ten thousand trees bloom.

poems.author: 刘禹锡
poems.title: 秋词
translation: Since ancient times autumn has meant sorrow;
I say an autumn day beats a spring morning.

poems.author: 刘禹锡
poems.title: 陋室铭
translation: Moss climbs the steps in green;
the grass lends its colour to the blinds.

poems.author: 白居易
poems.title: 赋得古原草送别
translation: Wildfire cannot burn it all;
when the spring wind blows, it grows again.

poems.author: 白居易
poems.title: 忆江南
translation: At sunrise the riverside flowers are redder than fire;
in spring the river is green as indigo.

lines: 绿蚁新醅酒，红泥小火炉。
晚来天欲雪，能饮一杯无？
poems.author: 白居易
poems.title: 问刘十九
translation: New wine, green with froth; a little red clay stove.
Evening comes and snow is near — will you have a cup?

poems.author: 白居易
poems.title: 钱塘湖春行
translation: Wild flowers begin to dazzle the eye;
the young grass barely covers a horse's hooves.

poems.author: 韩愈
poems.title: 早春呈水部张十八员外
translation: Light rain on the capital's streets, soft as butter;
the green of the grass shows from afar, but vanishes up close.

poems.author: 韩愈
poems.title: 进学解
translation: Skill grows with diligence and fades with play;
deeds succeed through thought and fail through carelessness.

poems.author: 杜牧
poems.title: 山行
translation: I stop my carriage, loving the maple wood at dusk;
frosted leaves are redder than February flowers.

poems.author: 杜牧
poems.title: 江南春
translation: Four hundred and eighty temples of the Southern Dynasties —
how many towers stand in the misty rain.

poems.author: 杜牧
poems.title: 秋夕
translation: The night on the palace steps is cool as water;
lying down, I watch the Cowherd and Weaver stars.

poems.author: 李商隐
poems.title: 夜雨寄北
translation: When will we trim the candle by the west window
and talk of this night's rain in the Ba hills?

lines: 松下问童子，言师采药去。
只在此山中，云深不知处。
poems.author: 贾岛
poems.title: 寻隐者不遇
translation: Under the pines I asked the boy; he said his master was out gathering herbs.
Somewhere on this mountain — the clouds are too deep to know where.

poems.author: 刘长卿
poems.title: 逢雪宿芙蓉山主人
translation: At the brushwood gate a dog barks:
someone coming home through the wind and snow.

poems.author: 高骈
poems.title: 山亭夏日
poems.title_en: Summer Day at a Mountain Pavilion
translation: Green trees cast deep shade, the summer day is long;
the terraces are mirrored in the pond.

poems.author: 王建
poems.title: 十五夜望月
translation: Tonight everyone looks up at the bright moon;
I wonder whose home autumn longing will fall on.

poems.author: 杜秋娘
poems.title: 金缕衣
translation: When flowers are ready to pick, pick them;
don't wait until only bare branches remain.

poems.author: 李峤
poems.title: 风
translation: It strips the leaves of late autumn,
and opens the flowers of early spring.

poems.author: 颜真卿
poems.title: 劝学
translation: With black hair, we don't know to study early;
with white hair, we regret reading too late.

poems.author: 苏轼
poems.title: 惠崇春江晚景
poems.title_en: Spring River at Dusk, after Huichong's Painting
translation: Beyond the bamboo, two or three sprays of peach blossom;
the ducks are first to know the river has warmed.

poems.author: 苏轼
poems.title: 和子由渑池怀旧
translation: What is life like, wherever we go?
Like a wild goose stepping on snow and mud.

poems.author: 苏轼
poems.title: 定风波
translation: Bamboo staff and straw sandals beat a horse — who's afraid?
In a straw cape I'll take the misty rain for life.

poems.author: 苏轼
poems.title: 定风波
translation: Looking back at the place of the storm, I head home:
no wind or rain, and no sunshine either.

poems.author: 苏轼
poems.title: 题西林壁
poems.title_en: Written on the Wall of Xilin Temple
translation: Seen across, a ridge; from the side, a peak;
near or far, high or low, it is never the same.

poems.author: 苏轼
poems.title: 饮湖上初晴后雨
poems.title_en: Drinking on the Lake, Sun Then Rain
translation: West Lake is like the beauty Xizi:
light makeup or heavy, she always looks right.

poems.author: 苏轼
poems.title: 赠刘景文
translation: Remember the best scene of the year:
when oranges turn yellow and tangerines are green.

poems.author: 苏轼
poems.title: 临江仙·送钱穆父
poems.title_en: Immortal by the River, Seeing Off Qian Mufu
translation: Life is an inn on the road;
I too am only passing through.

poems.author: 苏轼
poems.title: 望江南·超然台作
translation: Light a new fire and try the new tea;
enjoy poems and wine while you are young.

poems.author: 苏轼
poems.title: 春宵
translation: A moment of a spring night is worth a fortune;
the flowers are fragrant, the moon half in shadow.

poems.author: 苏轼
poems.title: 食荔枝
translation: Three hundred lychees a day —
I'd gladly live in the far south for good.

poems.author: 朱熹
poems.title: 观书有感
translation: How can the pond stay so clear?
Because fresh water flows in from its source.

poems.author: 朱熹
poems.title: 春日
translation: It is easy to know the face of the east wind:
ten thousand purples and reds — all of it spring.

poems.author: 陆游
poems.title: 冬夜读书示子聿
poems.title_en: Reading on a Winter Night, for My Son
translation: What you learn from paper always feels shallow;
to truly know a thing, you must do it yourself.

poems.author: 陆游
poems.title: 游山西村
poems.title_en: Visiting a Village West of the Hills
translation: Hills upon hills, streams upon streams — no way through, it seems;
then shady willows and bright flowers, and another village.

poems.author: 陆游
poems.title: 临安春雨初霁
translation: All night in my small room I hear the spring rain;
tomorrow they'll sell apricot blossoms in the lane.

poems.author: 杨万里
poems.title: 晓出净慈寺送林子方
poems.title_en: Seeing Off Lin Zifang from Jingci Temple at Dawn
translation: Lotus leaves meet the sky in endless green;
lotus flowers in the sun, a red like no other.

poems.author: 杨万里
poems.title: 小池
translation: A young lotus has just shown its pointed tip,
and already a dragonfly stands on top.

poems.author: 杨万里
poems.title: 宿新市徐公店
translation: Children run to chase a yellow butterfly;
it flies into the rape flowers and cannot be found.

poems.author: 叶绍翁
poems.title: 游园不值
translation: A garden full of spring cannot be shut in:
one branch of red apricot leans over the wall.

poems.author: 王安石
poems.title: 泊船瓜洲
translation: The spring wind greens the south bank again;
when will the bright moon light my way home?

poems.author: 王安石
poems.title: 登飞来峰
translation: I don't fear floating clouds blocking my view,
for I stand on the highest level.

poems.author: 王安石
poems.title: 梅花
translation: A few plum branches in the corner of the wall
bloom alone against the cold.

poems.author: 辛弃疾
poems.title: 西江月·夜行黄沙道中
poems.title_en: West River Moon, Walking the Huangsha Road at Night
translation: In the scent of rice flowers, talk of a good harvest;
listen to the frogs all around.

poems.author: 辛弃疾
poems.title: 菩萨蛮·书江西造口壁
poems.title_en: Written on a Wall at Zaokou
translation: The green hills cannot hold it back;
in the end the river flows east.

poems.author: 岳飞
poems.title: 满江红
translation: Don't idle until your young hair turns white,
only to grieve in vain.

poems.author: 晏殊
poems.title: 浣溪沙
translation: Nothing can stop the flowers from falling;
the swallows return, as if we had met before.

poems.author: 李清照
poems.title: 如梦令
translation: Don't you know, don't you know?
The green must be lush now, and the red grown thin.

poems.author: 李清照
poems.title: 一剪梅
translation: Flowers drift and fall, water flows on;
one longing, felt as sorrow in two places.

poems.author: 范仲淹
poems.title: 岳阳楼记
translation: Not made glad by things,
not made sad by one's own lot.

poems.author: 欧阳修
poems.title: 醉翁亭记
translation: The old drunkard's heart is not in the wine,
but in the hills and streams.

poems.author: 赵师秀
poems.title: 约客
translation: My guest has not come and it is past midnight;
idly tapping go stones, I knock the snuff from the lamp.

poems.author: 卢梅坡
poems.title: 雪梅
translation: The plum must yield to the snow in whiteness,
but the snow lacks the plum's fragrance.

poems.author: 范成大
poems.title: 四时田园杂兴
translation: By day they weed the fields, by night they spin hemp;
every son and daughter in the village does their part.

poems.author: 唐珙
poems.title: 题龙阳县青草湖
translation: Drunk, I forget the sky is in the water;
a boatful of clear dreams rests on the Milky Way.

poems.author: 纳兰性德
poems.title: 木兰花令
translation: If life were always like our first meeting,
why would the autumn wind make the painted fan sad?

poems.author: 龚自珍
poems.title: 己亥杂诗
translation: Fallen petals are not without feeling;
turned to spring soil, they nourish the flowers.

poems.author: 陶渊明
poems.title: 饮酒·其五
translation: Picking chrysanthemums by the eastern fence,
at ease, I see the southern hills.

poems.author: 陶渊明
poems.title: 杂诗
translation: Make the most of your time;
the years wait for no one.

poems.author: 曹操
poems.title: 龟虽寿
translation: An old steed in the stable still dreams of a thousand miles;
a hero in his late years keeps his great heart.

poems.author: 汉乐府
poems.title: 长歌行
translation: Make no effort while young,
and you will grieve in vain when old.

poems.author: 荀子
poems.title: 劝学
translation: Without adding up small steps, you never go a thousand miles;
without gathering small streams, there are no rivers or seas.

poems.author: 屈原
poems.title: 离骚
translation: The road ahead is long and far;
I will search high and low.
